https://mastodon.social/@cypherreport/11.text: US Rep Ritchie Torres introduces the Power to the Players Act, granting players ownership of digital games. The bill aims to protect players from game revocations, where a distributor or publisher takes back a purchased game license. If buying something means you don't own it, then stealing isn't theft. Actions like this bring balance back to the consumer, espeically in the gaming space. #Gaming #VideoGames
